deploybot: starting progressive rollout v2026-04-02-rc1 -> 10% eu-west at 11:03 UTC. monitors: p95, 5xx, kv-evict-rate. status: IN_PROGRESS
nina: seeing p95 climb in eu-west within 60s (180ms -> 420ms). 5xx still low but tail is noisy.
carl: logs point to repeated kvcache.eviction spikes on infer-eu-2 nodes. some NVML WARNs nearby.
priya: can we hold at 10% and not advance to 25% until infra verifies? prefer to pin region if needed.
tom_oncall: acknowledged, checking host metrics and kube OOM events. 2m ETA.
deploybot: current health: p95 +132%, 5xx 0.28% (baseline 0.11%).
priya: quick vote: pause? react :+1: pause, :-1: continue.
nina: +1 pause
carl: +1 pause
priya: +1 pause
tom_oncall: +1 pause
deploybot: consensus reached: pause. applying drain and pin for eu-west to v2026-03-30-stable.
deploybot: routing change applied. canary drained to 0% in eu-west, stable pinned. audit: action=paused; rollout=v2026-04-02-rc1; region=eu-west; reason="kvcache eviction surge -> p95 tail"
tom_oncall: infra restarted one worker with NVML trace, increased kvcache limit on pool and applied a temporary evict-threshold bump. monitoring.
carl: opening ticket REL-1318 with reproducer and heap traces. assign: infra+ml.
priya: adding note to release notes draft: "Canary paused in eu-west for rc1 due to kv-cache memory pressure; draining to stable and investigation opened (REL-1318)." brief and customer-facing.
docsbot: created REL-1318 and PM-RELEASE-RC1 postmortem placeholder.
priya: holding until load tests confirm stabilization. will reconvene for a slow 15% bump with stricter sentinels if cleared.
tom_oncall: timeline: pause @+45s, restart @+3m10s, kvcache bump @+4m, drain @+5m. marking mitigated for now.
nina: thanks all. will post perf graphs when available.
deploybot: thread audit: action=paused; ticket=REL-1318; note="kvcache eviction surge causing tail latency"
